'''2009 2K Event Day 2 Chris Fanchi DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Fanchi]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Star Wars is Fun!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
